title: Kagamine Rin — Lit By The Screen〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks for bringing a copy of that film over for us, you guys♪ It was sooo good☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you liked it so much!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Even after we finished watching it, you asked to rewatch all those scenes over and over!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Because I wanted to go back and revisit those scenes at the end! I wanted to remember who did what and who talked to who!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We all seemed to enjoy it, but you definitely showed the most interest, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When it's ready, we'll bring over the one we're shooting now. I'm sure it'll be fun to compare this to that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, since the stories are so different!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
I can't wait to see what it's about☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I can show you my copy of the script. I just happened to bring it by today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes, I wanna see♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course!
Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, it's a real script for a real movie!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's start going through it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmmmm...
So many hard words! I don't get what's going on!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, there's more than a few of those. It is sort of meant for a grown-up audience.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you guys all appear together in one scene, right? I wanna see that☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We appear in Scene 15... Ah, it's this page.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When the protagonist and his sister go for a walk on the beach, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?! What kinds of roles do you guys play?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm Girl C, who sits on a bench while feeding the pigeons!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm Young Man E, who gazes at the sea while leaning against the fence.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm playing Girl J, who's having a picnic on the grass...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I am Young Man A! The fellow admiring some flowers whilst squatting next to them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, that sounds like fun!
I can't wait to see you guys during this scene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, fair warning...
The possibility still remains that our scene doesn't make the final cut. It's not like any of us are speaking.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! Is that true?!
But you still have to work really hard on playing your characters... I didn't realize how brutal filmmaking can be...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Brutal... Yeah, that might be a good way to put it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But this is also a golden opportunity for us since we get to work with a professional film crew.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. And now, not only get to be in the film, we even get to help the production team.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is going to be a learning experience the likes of which we've never before encountered!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. We get to work alongside professionals working to complete this film...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that sense, film and theatre are one and the same. So, we should try to learn as much as we can wherever we go.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
I'm gonna talk to as many of the crew members as I can and learn lots and lots from them!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You all sound very excited about this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it's clear that you're all raring to get started on it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
I know that things might get tough...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I promise to give you all the support I can☆
